title: Print labels
intro: Location, article and order labels with Code 128. Directly from the browser to an office printer (single label or A4 sheet) or as a ZPL file for a Zebra printer.
printHint: In the browser's print dialog set the scaling to 100 % (“Actual size”) and the margins to “None”, otherwise the grid does not fit on the sheet and the barcodes are distorted. The ZPL file contains the chosen labels (copies via ^PQ) and is sent to the Zebra printer or opened in Zebra Designer.
tooMany: Too many labels for printing in the browser: {{total}} (at most {{max}} per print job). Choose fewer labels or copies; for large quantities use the ZPL download (the printer then multiplies the copies).

unreadable.title: Cannot be shown as Code 128:
unreadable.note: These labels show the code as text only.

tooDense.text: Too long for this format: the bars would be narrower than {{min}} mm, which makes scanning unreliable. A larger format (A4 sheet) or a shorter code helps.
